services.name: Architectural Services
services.text: Concept to working drawings for residential, commercial, institutional, industrial and interior projects; township and layout planning; green building design.

services.name: Structural Consultancy
services.text: Structural design of multi-storey structures (low-rise and high-rise, up to 50+ storeys), steel and RCC structures, industrial structures, and earthquake-resistant design (Zone IV experience).
examples: 2B+30 storey towers in Ghaziabad for Landcraft Developers
2B+S+30 storey towers in Gurgaon for Landcraft / Aashiana
In the Middle East, 50+ storey structures designed while working with various consulting organisations

services.name: MEP Services
services.text: Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing design delivered through co-consultants as a full package with architecture and structure.

services.name: Interiors
services.text: Office and institutional interiors — e.g. ADAP TV office (Madhapur, HITEC City) and simulation lab at GSL Medical College.

services.name: Peer Review & Value Engineering
services.text: Independent review of structural designs to make them safer and more economical. Example: replacing RCC columns with RCC shear walls on Landcraft's 2B+30 storey towers saved about ₹6 crore in reinforcement.

tiers.intro: Offered at three levels. Each level includes everything in the one before. To begin, we need the design basis report prepared by the main consultant and signed by the client.

levels.name: Independent check
includes: We build our own analysis model, in our own software.
We check the member sizes on the main consultant's drawings against gravity, wind and earthquake loads.
Where a section falls short, we say so and recommend a size.
levels.terms: One-time. No part in later revisions or in construction.

levels.name: Check and optimise
includes: Member sizes optimised, in discussion with the main consultant and the client.
Drawings revised where needed, with the main consultant.
levels.terms: Two months at the least, depending on when drawings are issued.

levels.name: Through construction
includes: Consultancy continued through the construction period, where the client asks for it.
levels.terms: Charged in addition to the review.

services.name: Project Management Consultancy (PMC)
services.text: Design solutions during execution, tender advisory, quantity surveying (QS) and site supervision (e.g. Punj Lloyd, Indu Projects, Sunway Opus).

technologies.name: Construction Technologies
technologies.text: Precast, monolithic (Mivan / aluminium formwork), composite, insulated wall (EPS / shotcrete), light gauge steel, Perma form and timber.

items.name: Precast construction
items.text: Factory-made concrete elements assembled on site — faster, economical, consistent quality. Used for housing, hostels, pharma and industrial buildings.

images.alt: Precast towers under construction with cranes

items.name: Monolithic (Mivan / aluminium formwork)
items.text: Walls and slabs cast together in one pour — ideal for repetitive mass housing and high-rise towers.

items.name: Composite construction
items.text: Structural steel frame with concrete deck / panels — light and quick to erect.

items.name: Insulated wall (EPS panel / shotcrete)
items.text: EPS core panels sprayed with concrete — thermal insulation and fast construction.

items.name: Light Gauge Steel (LGS)
items.text: Cold-formed steel framing for low-rise buildings.

items.name: Perma form
items.text: Permanent formwork panels that stay as part of the wall.

items.name: Polymer wall construction
items.text: Used for projects in Andhra Pradesh.

items.name: Timber / wooden structures
items.text: Glulam and timber structures (designed in Dubai, UAE).
